reranked_evidence.snippet: Infosecurity Magazine Home » News » A New Ransomware Threat Actor Emerges Every Week, Warns Report. # A New Ransomware Threat Actor Emerges Every Week, Warns Report. Published on July 21, the *Black Kite Ransomware Report 2026* identified 146 active ransomware groups which have publicly announced at least one victim of an attack, as of June 2026. According to the study, 2026 alone has seen the emergence of 61 new ransomware groups, the equivalent of more than one a week. Black Kite noted that ransomware operations can disappear as quickly as they emerge, with the average lifespan of an active group standing at 4.9 months, compared with over a year in 2024. Despite the fragmentation of the ransomware ecosystem, it is a handful of ransomware groups which continue to dominate the market, with the top five operations accounting for almost half (44%) of 7551 public disclosed victims between March 2025 and March 2026.
